page.content:
1995 sequel where Kazuya sits the Zaibatsu throne.

How Tekken 2 connects

  • Character: Kazuya Mishima — Tekken 2 is the chapter in which Kazuya sits the Zaibatsu throne.
  • Character: Jun Kazama — Tekken 2 introduced Jun Kazama into Kazuya's orbit.
  • Topic: Tekken — Tekken 2 is the sequel that seated Kazuya on the Zaibatsu throne.

What is Tekken 2?

Tekken 2 is the arcade sequel in which Kazuya rules the Mishima Zaibatsu, Jun enters his orbit, and Heihachi returns from the ravine to take the company back.

Key threads lead to Kazuya Mishima, Jun Kazama and Tekken.
